dedupe_keys.name: standardized precipitation index spi recent conditions

description: Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) Recent Conditions is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. Droughts are natural occurring events in which dry conditions persist over time. Droughts are complex to characterize because they depend on water and energy balances at different temporal and spatial scales. The Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) is used to analyze meteorological droughts. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are Drought, Precipitation, Environment, Standardized Precipitation Index, SPI, Live Feeds, livefeeds2. The bounding box given is -180.0000,-50.0000,-179.9057,49.9360. The hub shows 2026-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
